name: Remortgage or product switch
nudge: Fit measures before you switch: they may qualify for lender cashback. Check current terms.
why: You are already talking to your lender.
source: ARKRA product demo assumption · team brief, 8 November 2026

name: Buying a home
nudge: See this home’s climate risk before you commit.
why: A home purchase is a moment to plan ahead.
source: ARKRA product demo assumption · team brief, 8 November 2026

name: Insurance renewal
nudge: Show your Home Resilience Passport to your insurer. It records the work you have done.
source: ARKRA product demo assumption · team brief, 8 November 2026

name: After a flood claim
nudge: Your insurer may pay up to £10,000 for resilience through Flood Re’s Build Back Better scheme, if it takes part. Check current terms.
why: Resilience can be installed while repairs happen.
source: ARKRA product demo assumption · team brief, 8 November 2026

name: Flood or heat warning
nudge: Check warnings. Move valuables upstairs if flooding threatens. Keep rooms shaded and check on vulnerable neighbours in hot weather.
why: Small timely actions can reduce disruption.
source: ARKRA product demo assumption · team brief, 8 November 2026

name: EPC expiring
nudge: Get a new EPC to see your progress and update your record.
why: A fresh certificate can evidence improvement.
source: ARKRA product demo assumption · team brief, 8 November 2026
